entries.en: Claude Opus 4.7 xhigh is now available! Use /effort to tune speed vs. intelligence
entries.zh: Claude Opus 4.7 xhigh 现已上市！使用/努力来调整速度与智力

entries.en: Auto mode is now available for Max subscribers when using Opus 4.7
entries.zh: 使用 Opus 4.7 时，自动模式现在可供最大订阅者使用

entries.en: Added `xhigh` effort level for Opus 4.7, sitting between `high` and `max`. Available via `/effort`, `--effort`, and the model picker; other models fall back to `high`
entries.zh: 为 Opus 4.7 添加了`xhigh`努力级别，位于`high`和`max`之间。通过`/effort`、`--effort`和模型选择器可用；其他型号回落至“高位”

entries.en: Added "Auto (match terminal)" theme option that matches your terminal's dark/light mode — select it from `/theme`
entries.zh: 添加了与您的终端的暗/亮模式相匹配的“自动（匹配终端）”主题选项 - 从`/theme`中选择它

entries.en: Added `/less-permission-prompts` skill — scans transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls and proposes a prioritized allowlist for `.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: 添加了`/less-permission-prompts`技能 - 扫描常见只读 Bash 和 MCP 工具调用的记录，并为`.claude/settings.json`提出优先允许列表

entries.en: Added `/ultrareview` for running comprehensive code review in the cloud using parallel multi-agent analysis and critique — invoke with no arguments to review your current branch, or `/ultrareview <PR#>` to fetch and review a specific GitHub PR
entries.zh: 添加了`/ultrareview`，用于使用并行多代理分析和评论在云中运行全面的代码审查 - 不带参数调用来审查当前分支，或`/ultrareview <PR#>`来获取和审查特定的 GitHub PR

entries.en: Suggest the closest matching subcommand when `claude <word>` is invoked with a near-miss typo (e.g. `claude udpate` → "Did you mean `claude update`?")
entries.zh: 执行 `claude <词>` 时如果拼错，现在会提示最接近的子命令（例如 `claude udpate` → "Did you mean `claude update`?"）

entries.en: `/skills` menu now supports sorting by estimated token count — press `t` to toggle
entries.zh: `/skills` 菜单现在支持按估算的 token 数排序，按 `t` 切换

entries.en: Headless `--output-format stream-json` now includes `plugin_errors` on the init event when plugins are demoted for unsatisfied dependencies
entries.zh: 无界面模式 `--output-format stream-json` 的 init 事件中，插件因依赖不满足被降级时，现在会包含 `plugin_errors`

entries.en: Added `OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES` environment variable to emit full API request and response bodies as OpenTelemetry log events for debugging
entries.zh: 添加了`OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES`环境变量，以将完整的 API 请求和响应正文作为 OpenTelemetry 日志事件发出以进行调试

entries.en: `/effort` now opens an interactive slider when called without arguments, with arrow-key navigation between levels and Enter to confirm
entries.zh: 不带参数调用 `/effort` 时，现在会打开交互式滑块，可用方向键切换级别、按 Enter 确认

entries.en: Auto mode no longer requires `--enable-auto-mode`
entries.zh: 自动模式不再需要`--enable-auto-mode`

entries.en: Windows: PowerShell tool is progressively rolling out. Opt in or out with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL`. On Linux and macOS, enable with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=1` (requires `pwsh` on PATH)
entries.zh: Windows：PowerShell 工具正在逐步推出。可用 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL` 选择开启或关闭。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，用 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=1` 开启（需要 PATH 中有 `pwsh`）

entries.en: Read-only bash commands with glob patterns (e.g. `ls *.ts`) and commands starting with `cd <project-dir> &&` no longer trigger a permission prompt
entries.zh: 带通配符的只读 bash 命令（如 `ls *.ts`），以及以 `cd <项目目录> &&` 开头的命令，不再触发权限提示

entries.en: Plan files are now named after your prompt (e.g. `fix-auth-race-snug-otter.md`) instead of purely random words
entries.zh: 计划文件现在以你的提示命名（如 `fix-auth-race-snug-otter.md`），而不再完全使用随机词

entries.en: Improved `/setup-vertex` and `/setup-bedrock` to show the actual `settings.json` path when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set, seed model candidates from existing pins on re-run, and offer a "with 1M context" option for supported models
entries.zh: 改进 `/setup-vertex` 和 `/setup-bedrock`：设置了 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 时显示实际的 `settings.json` 路径；重新运行时以已有的固定模型作为候选；对支持的模型提供“1M 上下文”选项

entries.en: `Ctrl+U` now clears the entire input buffer (previously: delete to start of line); press `Ctrl+Y` to restore
entries.zh: `Ctrl+U` 现在会清空整个输入缓冲区（此前是删到行首）；按 `Ctrl+Y` 可恢复

entries.en: `Ctrl+L` now forces a full screen redraw in addition to clearing the prompt input
entries.zh: `Ctrl+L` 现在除了清空提示输入外，还会强制整个屏幕重绘

entries.en: Transcript view footer now shows `[` (dump to scrollback) and `v` (open in editor) shortcuts
entries.zh: 转录视图的底部现在显示 `[`（输出到回滚缓冲区）和 `v`（在编辑器中打开）快捷键

entries.en: The "+N lines" marker for truncated long pastes is now a full-width rule for easier scanning
entries.zh: 长粘贴被截断时的 "+N lines" 标记改为全宽分隔线，更容易扫读

entries.en: Improved plugin error handling: dependency errors now distinguish conflicting, invalid, and overly complex version requirements; fixed stale resolved versions after `plugin update`; `plugin install` now recovers from interrupted prior installs
entries.zh: 改进插件错误处理：依赖错误现在能区分冲突、无效和过于复杂的版本要求；修复了 `plugin update` 后残留的旧版本号问题；`plugin install` 现在能从之前中断的安装中恢复

entries.en: Suppressed spurious decompression, network, and transient error messages that could appear in the TUI during normal operation
entries.zh: 隐藏正常运行时终端界面中偶尔出现的解压、网络和临时错误提示

entries.en: Reverted the v2.1.110 cap on non-streaming fallback retries — it traded long waits for more outright failures during API overload
entries.zh: 撤销了 v2.1.110 中对非流式回退重试次数的上限：它在 API 过载时以更长的等待换来了更多直接失败，弊大于利

entries.en: Fixed terminal display tearing (random characters, drifting input) in iTerm2 + tmux setups when terminal notifications are sent
entries.zh: 修复在 iTerm2 + tmux 环境下发送终端通知时，终端显示撕裂（随机字符、输入漂移）的问题

entries.en: Fixed `@` file suggestions re-scanning the entire project on every turn in non-git working directories, and showing only config files in freshly-initialized git repos with no tracked files
entries.zh: 修复了`@`文件建议，每次在非 git 工作目录中重新扫描整个项目，并仅显示新初始化的 git 存储库中的配置文件，而没有跟踪文件

entries.en: Fixed LSP diagnostics from before an edit appearing after it, causing the model to re-read files it just edited
entries.zh: 修复了编辑之前出现的 LSP 诊断，导致模型重新读取刚刚编辑的文件

entries.en: Fixed tab-completing `/resume` immediately resuming an arbitrary titled session instead of showing the session picker
entries.zh: 修复 Tab 补全 `/resume` 时直接恢复了某个随机命名的会话，而不是显示会话选择器的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/context` grid rendering with extra blank lines between rows
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`网格渲染，行之间有额外的空白行

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` dropping the session name set by `/rename`, causing statusline output to lose `session_name`
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`删除`/rename`设置的会话名称，导致状态行输出丢失`session_name`的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude calling a non-existent `commit` skill and showing "Unknown skill: commit" for users without a custom `/commit` command
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德调用不存在的`commit`技能并为没有自定义`/commit`命令的用户显示“未知技能：提交”的问题

entries.en: Fixed 429 rate-limit errors on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry referencing status.claude.com (it only covers Anthropic-operated providers)
entries.zh: 修复了引用 status.claude.com 的 Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry 上的 429 个速率限制错误（仅涵盖 Anthropic 运营的提供商）

entries.en: Fixed feedback surveys appearing back-to-back after dismissing one
entries.zh: 修正了反馈调查在驳回后连续出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed bare URLs in bash/PowerShell/MCP tool output being unclickable when the terminal wraps them across lines
entries.zh: 修复了终端将 bash/PowerShell/MCP 工具输出中的裸 URL 换行时无法单击的问题

entries.en: Windows: `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` and SessionStart hook environment files now apply (previously a no-op)
entries.zh: Windows：`CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` 和 SessionStart 钩子的环境文件现在会生效（之前没有作用）

entries.en: Windows: permission rules with drive-letter paths are now correctly root-anchored, and paths differing only by drive-letter case are recognized as the same path
entries.zh: Windows：带盘符的路径权限规则现在正确以根目录为锚点，仅盘符大小写不同的路径被识别为同一路径
